1d1f5f0e.name: Portfolio Optimisation — Sharpe Ratio Maximisation
1d1f5f0e.description: Test whether rebalancing allocation using rolling-window Sharpe maximisation improves risk-adjusted returns vs static 60/40.

hypothesis.statement: Dynamic rebalancing based on 90-day rolling Sharpe ratios will outperform static 60/40

aaecf719.name: Cashflow Forecast Accuracy — ML vs Rule-based
aaecf719.description: Compare 30-day cashflow forecast accuracy between rule-based projection and ML regression model.

hypothesis.statement: ML regression model achieves ≥15% lower MAPE than rule-based forecast

77d9c2f7.name: Tax Optimisation — Tax-Loss Harvesting Impact
